name: Test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - '*'
    paths:
      - '**.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/test.yml'
      - 'index.js'
      - 'conf/*'
      - 'hooks/*'



concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true



jobs:
  # The sync jobs are gated on two levels, and both are needed.
  #
  # Level 1 -- the VM_TEST_EXCLUDE_<METHOD> matrix excludes below (baked by
  # generate.yml from the same per-arch map as the step `if:`s): drop the legs
  # whose arch does not support this job's method, so they never spawn.
  #
  # Level 2 -- this job-level `if:`. When NO arch supports the method, level 1
  # strips EVERY leg, and GitHub then runs the job ONCE with all matrix values
  # empty instead of zero times (community discussion 179993, open and
  # undocumented). That leftover leg would be one more green do-nothing job, so
  # the repo-level gate turns it into a real skip. This is the string-grep form
  # used by testtar/test9p, for the same reason it is used there: no method name
  # is a substring of another method name or of any arch key in the map.
  testsshfs:
    if: ${{ contains('{"x86_64":["rsync","scp","sshfs","nfs","tar"],"aarch64":["rsync","scp","sshfs","nfs","tar"],"riscv64":["rsync","scp","sshfs","nfs","tar"],"powerpc64":["nfs","scp","tar"],"sparc64":[],"ppc64le":[],"s390x":[],"i386":[],"loongarch64":[],"armv7":[]}', 'sshfs') }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        release: [ "13.2", "13.3", "13.4", "13.5", "14.0", "14.1", "14.2", "14.3", "14.4", "14.5", "15.0", "15.1", "10.4", "11.4", "15.0-zfs", "15.1-zfs"
 ]
        arch: [ "aarch64", "", "riscv64", "powerpc64", "sparc64", "ppc64le", "s390x", "i386", "loongarch64", "armv7"]
        runs: [ "ubuntu-26.04", "ubuntu-26.04-arm"]
        exclude:
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: ""
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "riscv64"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "powerpc64"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "sparc64"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "ppc64le"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "s390x"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "i386"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "loongarch64"
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04-arm"
            arch: "armv7"
          # aarch64 on the x86 runner (TCG) is booted by the rsync matrix;
          # the sync transport itself does not depend on TCG vs KVM, so
          # these legs only repeat what the ubuntu-26.04-arm legs test.
          - runs: "ubuntu-26.04"
            arch: "aarch64"
          # Manual matrix excludes only; combos with no conf are auto-excluded.
          - release: "13.2"
            arch: sparc64
          - release: "13.2"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
